name: How long does the painting and finishing process take for a typical room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does the painting and finishing process take for a typical room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of painting and finishing for a room addition can vary based on the size of the addition, the complexity of the architectural details, and the type of finishes chosen. Generally, for a single room addition, it can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This includes time for proper surface preparation, drying time between coats, and the application of all finishes. Larger additions or those with custom finishes will naturally require more time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting and finishing for a room addition typically takes 3 to 7 days, depending on size and complexity.
